[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Limit naps: Keep naps short (20-30 minutes) and avoid napping close to bedtime.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Get some morning sunlight: Exposure to natural light in the morning helps regulate circadian rhythms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Avoid substances that can disrupt sleep: Limit alcohol consumption and avoid medications that interfere with sleep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Try relaxation techniques: Practice mindfulness meditation, visualization, or guided imagery.
